longterm.name: Brook Lopez

The concern is obvious at age 38, especially after an uneven 2025-26 season. Still, the minutes should be there if he stays healthy. Lopez is worth a flier for managers looking for threes and blocks.

Brooks was even better in the playoffs, averaging 26.0 PPG and 6.0 RPG across four games against Oklahoma City. Brooks should remain an important part of the Suns’ rotation, but the return of Jalen Green and addition of Miles Bridges could reduce his scoring opportunities. He’s worth a flier at the end of drafts for managers looking for points, threes and steals.

Sexton can create off the dribble, attack the rim and provide secondary playmaking, but a reserve role behind Luka Doncic and Austin Reaves limits his ceiling. He’s a source of points and triples, but is most likely a waiver wire add unless you are in a deeper league.
